title: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility with Multivariate Fractional Brownian Motion
abstract: arXiv:2504.15985v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A multivariate fractional Brownian motion (mfBm) with component-wise Hurst exponents is used to model and forecast realized volatility (RV). We investigate the interplay between correlation coefficients and Hurst exponents and propose a novel method to estimate model parameters, establishing its consistency and asymptotic normality. Additionally, we develop a time-reversibility test, which is typically not rejected by RV data. When the data generating process is a time-reversible mfBm, we derive optimal forecasting formulae and analyze their properties. A key insight is that an mfBm with different Hurst exponents and non-zero correlations can reduce forecasting errors compared to a one-dimensional model. Consistent with this theory, out-of-sample forecasts using the time-reversible mfBm show improvements over univariate fBm, particularly when the estimated Hurst exponents differ significantly. translated_title: 基于多元分数布朗运动的已实现波动率建模与预测
translated_abstract: 本文采用具有分量级赫斯特指数的多元分数布朗运动（mfBm）来建模和预测已实现波动率（RV）。我们研究了相关系数与赫斯特指数之间的相互作用，并提出了一种新的模型参数估计方法，建立了其一致性和渐近正态性。此外，我们开发了一个时间可逆性检验，该检验通常不会被RV数据拒绝。当数据生成过程是时间可逆的mfBm时，我们推导了最优预测公式并分析了其性质。一个关键见解是，与一维模型相比，具有不同赫斯特指数和非零相关性的mfBm可以降低预测误差。与该理论一致，使用时间可逆mfBm的样本外预测显示出相对于单变量fBm的改进，特别是在估计的赫斯特指数显著不同时。实证结果表明，mfBm在预测已实现波动率方面具有优越性。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于多元分数布朗运动的已实现波动率建模与预测方法，通过引入分量级赫斯特指数和非零相关性，显著降低了预测误差，并提供了理论估计和实证验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multivariate fractional Brownian motion-based method for modeling and forecasting realized volatility, which reduces forecasting errors by incorporating component-wise Hurst exponents and non-zero correlations, with theoretical estimation and empirical validation.
